newsitem.title: USA: Ameritech long-distance plan hits snag - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Ameritech long-distance plan hits snag - WSJ.

text.p: Ameritech Corp's plan to become the first Baby Bell to offer long-distance telecommunications has hit a snag due to discrepancies and errors in its filing with the Federal Communications Commission, The Wall Street Journal reported Wednesday.

Competitors who examined the FCC filing and regulators in Michigan who are considering Ameritech's application to enter the long-distance market found the company gave two different versions of contracts it cited in support of its application, the story said, citing regulators and industry executives.
An Ameritech spokesman is quoted as saying the company will ask the FCC to "restart the clock" due to the "inadvertent omissions."
The story quoted people familiar with the matter who said the errors made it appear that Ameritech had a stronger case to enter the long-distance market than it actually does.
